verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents deleting or editing codes, a Trash section that supports recovery or permanent deletion, and deleting unparseable codes. Users can also control where data is kept: offline mode stores codes only on the device, local backups go to a location the user chooses, the server can be self-hosted, and codes can be exported via the CLI. missing for 10: documented account deletion or server-side data purge, stated cloud backup/trash retention periods, independent hands-on corroboration of deletion behavior.
